name: afterhours-pitch-animation
description: The Afterhours pitch as an animated video (Remotion). Timings from docs/video/pitch.md; every number from artifacts/report/numbers.json.

scripts.render: npm run sfx && remotion render Pitch out/afterhours-pitch.mp4 && scripts/loudness.sh out/afterhours-pitch.mp4
scripts.render:script: npm run sfx && remotion render PitchWithScript out/afterhours-pitch-with-script.mp4 && scripts/loudness.sh out/afterhours-pitch-with-script.mp4
scripts.setup:voice: uv venv --python 3.12 .tts && uv pip install --python .tts/bin/python kokoro==0.9.4 soundfile https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/download/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0-py3-none-any.whl
